_readme: NY_SCH - Tier 2 PRE. Copy into fe-jobs/all/ (one run for every instrument, 2026-10-08); the agent asks every <ask>.

2026-10-07: BOX expert review fixes - DEV host in the folder file, per-environment values (controlm.env), core db.conf call (target.dbconf_format, branch_pk, core_time), constant values, answers already known (renames, external_events). An existing fe-jobs/<instrument>/fe-jobs-inputs.json: add these keys, keep its own answers.
2026-10-08: all instruments in one run (`instrument` is a list), Initial Accounting jobs (db.conf + hand-off to box-acc-jobs-agent), OrderMethod per environment, the Unix package (job_unix.sh).

2026-10-09: excluded books (books/books-excluded.csv), target repos (PR after the operator's yes), the Unix package as the Tier 1 CDS one (delete + add, db_nuevo.conf, db_delete.txt, NY's delete_jobsBX.ksh), DROP-REVIEW, look-alikes by group (J-E4b). A one-instrument run: set `instrument` to "depos".

2026-10-09 (2): scheduling monitor (prerequisites[1], select: instruments, group 39073.21 -> 2935.65), unix.existing_scripts (add_new_jobs.ksh is in /gmny/etc), target.local_group_suffix. Runs are versioned: scripts/new_run.py.
